question: Of the One Piece world's mail delivery staff, can the Carrier Bats deliver packages too? Do pirate crews exchange mid and end of year gifts with each other? Ham
answer: I don't want to see pirates getting along like that. It doesn't happen. Carrier Bats are mainly used as a means of contact by the World Government. For private letters, one can negotiate with a News Coo to deliver it. There's also a private company called "Small Bird Delivery", but they have a small space and short distance. "Albatross Delivery" does long distance, but there's a lot of things they won't deliver. Mail services outside of the government's just aren't that developed. For deliveries between pirates, it's common to use boats. They don't have addresses either, so parting ways with people is heavier than we can imagine.
name: Boneless Ham
